answer: The reef schedule is applied in ridge and spiral exposes each instalment. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 650 impostors cost 1279 times the honest price and take 2 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
